name: econ-mine-and-cap
notes: M2 step 6 gate. (a) Mine what you lack: new alien bases go to sites rich in what the fleet is built from (metals, nobles), not more ice; alien metal income rises. (b) Exotics upkeep replaces the fixed base cap: bases grow past the vanilla cap while the exotics drip and stockpile allow. Vanilla holds 13 bases in every 2034 run so far.
asserts: len([e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')]) >= 1

sum(e['yields']['Metals'] + e['yields']['NobleMetals'] for e in [e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')]) >= 0.5 * sum(sum(e['yields'].values()) for e in [e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')])
info: [(e['t'], e['body'], e['yields']) for e in [e for e in events('hab+', faction='AlienCouncil', habType='Base') if e.get('yields')]]
[(e['t'], e['bases'], e['cap'], round(e['drip'], 1), round(e['upkeep'], 1), e['stock']['Exotics']) for e in events('economy')]
